title: This tiny gamepad with dual analog thumbsticks pushes the limits of portable controllers
summary: As much as I appreciate the ingenious design of the Nintendo Switch's Joy-Con, my family and I can't stand using them as standalone gamepads. So when we travel with the Switch 2, we always bring at least one full-size gamepad, plus a couple of 8BitDo's Zero 2 controllers for games that don't use analog thumbsticks. […]
llm_summary: The author praises the Nintendo Switch’s Joy‑Con design but finds them uncomfortable as solo controllers, especially on the go. When traveling with the upcoming Switch 2, they pack a full‑size gamepad for most titles and a pair of 8BitDo Zero 2 mini controllers for games that don’t need analog sticks. This combination lets them enjoy the console’s portability without sacrificing the feel of a traditional gamepad.
